basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Alberta Graduate Entrance Scholarship & Centenary Award
basic_details.offering_entity: Faculty of Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies (GPS), University of Alberta
basic_details.major_restrictions: All thesis-based master's and doctoral programs across Faculty of Science (Computing Science, AI via Amii), Faculty of Engineering (Biomedical, Chemical, Mechanical, Civil), Agricultural, Life & Environmental Sciences, and Medicine & Dentistry.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~150 to 200 graduate entrance scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally on merit; Pakistani graduate researchers frequently secure awards in Computing Science and Chemical Engineering (~15 to 25 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for thesis Master's; up to 4 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: CAD 17,500 / year (Master's) to CAD 21,000 / year (Doctoral) stipend plus CAD 10,000 international tuition differential top-up (~CAD 2,290 / month total funding; ~PKR 470,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: International students of all citizenships including Pakistan and Canadian domestic scholars
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; evaluation based on undergraduate and graduate academic GPA and research achievement.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum admission GPA of 3.70 / 4.00 (or first-class standing / 80%+) for Master's; 18-year Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.70 / 4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum admission GPA of 3.7 / 4.0 in final two years of study; competitive applicants typically hold 3.8+ / 4.0.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree in relevant discipline (computer science, engineering, biological sciences, physical sciences) with thesis component.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree prior to Canadian fall intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications, software repository contributions, or laboratory research assistantships carry significant weight.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (no band below 6.0), TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (subscores 21+), or Duolingo English Test 120+ mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: GRE General recommended but not mandatory for Computing Science and Engineering.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be admitted to an eligible full-time thesis-based graduate program and nominated by their academic department.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another major tri-agency award (CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC) or Vanier CGS without reduction.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition differential fee covered via CAD 10,000 top-up grant plus departmental tuition remission.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~CAD 9,500 to 11,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,950,000 to 2,250,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable graduate application fee of CAD 135 paid online upon application submission.

accommodation.details: Graduate student residence or off-campus housing in Edmonton arranged independently; easily covered by the combined stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~CAD 800 to 1,200 / month rent in Edmonton)

monthly_stipend.details: Annual stipend of CAD 17,500 (Master's) or CAD 21,000 (Doctoral) supplemented by departmental GRA/GTA appointments for a total guaranteed funding of CAD 26,000 to 32,000 / year.
monthly_stipend.amount: CAD 2,160 to 2,660 / month total guaranteed funding (~PKR 440,000 to 545,000 / mo)

airfare.details: Relocation flights to Edmonton are self-funded or subsidized by supervisor project travel funds.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit (~CAD 150) and biometrics fee (~CAD 85) paid directly to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC).

health_insurance.details: University of Alberta Student Union Health and Dental Plan plus Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan (AHCIP) coverage provided to international students holding 12+ month study permits at zero premium cost.

food_allowance.details: Daily groceries and campus dining funded from monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Departmental research workstations, high-performance computing clusters (Compute Canada / Amii resources), and library repositories provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: GPS Graduate Student Travel Awards provide up to CAD 1,500 per year for presenting research papers at national and international conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to CAD 1,500 / year travel award

travel_transit_allowance.details: Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) Universal Transit Pass (U-Pass) included in student fees providing unlimited bus and LRT transit throughout Edmonton.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single Canadian U15 research powerhouse (University of Alberta).
participating_institutions: University of Alberta (North Campus, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #96, CSRankings #1 in Canada and Top 5 globally for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (home to Amii - Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute).
available_majors: MSc / PhD in Computing Science (AI, Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning)
MSc / PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering
MSc / PhD in Chemical and Materials Engineering
MSc / PhD in Biological Sciences (Genetics, Microbiology)
MSc / PhD in Physics and Geophysics
MSc / PhD in Pharmacology and Oncology
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.70 / 4.0, verified transcripts, IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+, three academic letters of recommendation, CV, statement of purpose, and prospective supervisor support.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Department of Computing Science (Amii AI lab) is globally ultra-competitive with acceptance rates below 5%; securing supervisor confirmation prior to applying is strongly encouraged.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight prior machine learning projects or engineering thesis work; reference specific UofA research laboratories (Amii, NanoFAB, NRC Nanotechnology) in your research statement.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Alberta Graduate Online Application System (GSMS)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant profile on GSMS portal, select thesis-based graduate program, identify potential supervisors, upload academic transcripts, English scores, CV, statement of intent, and pay CAD 135 application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify eligible thesis supervisor in target academic department and make email contact with CV and research abstract.
Step 2: Ensure valid IELTS (6.5+), TOEFL (90+), or Duolingo (120+) score report is ready.
Step 3: Submit online admission application via GSMS portal and pay CAD 135 fee.
Step 4: Upload official transcripts, CV, statement of intent, and referee contact details.
Step 5: Referees submit electronic assessment letters directly into the GSMS portal.
Step 6: Departmental graduate admissions committee reviews application, offers admission, and automatically nominates top candidates to Faculty of GPS for Graduate Entrance Scholarship.
Step 7: GPS awards entrance scholarship; department supplements with GRA/GTA funding package.
Step 8: Accept offer, receive provincial attestation letter (PAL), and apply for Canadian Study Permit.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Departmental Nomination: Applicants are automatically considered and nominated by their admitting department without separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted electronically via automated referee appraisal links generated by GSMS.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of intent (1 to 2 pages) describing research experience, academic goals, alignment with faculty research, and long-term career objectives.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief 1 to 2-page research summary outlining target research area, methodologies, and proposed contribution.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV highlighting degree coursework, GPA, publications, software libraries, and research projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Supervisory video interview via Zoom/Google Meet to evaluate technical competency and research synergy.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 90+ mandatory; GRE optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official HEC Pakistan verified transcripts required upon conditional admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified English translation of non-English academic documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via University of Alberta GSMS portal.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: December 15 (Early / International round) / January 15 (Final department round)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake starts in September (Fall). Thesis-based programs strongly prioritize applications submitted by December 15.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior research thesis, publications, and laboratory projects)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity and focus of statement of intent)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee and Faculty of Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies (GPS) Awards Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Competitive multi-tiered ranking based on admission GPA, research track record, and supervisor sponsorship.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 to 200 graduate entrance scholarships across university
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% to 6.5% for applicants with GPA >= 3.7 and published research
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate CGPA >= 3.80 / 4.00, often with conference or journal publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top-tier graduates from recognized universities with strong coding or laboratory skills, clear research focus, and supervisor backing.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from premier Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, UET Lahore, Quaid-i-Azam, COMSATS).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Canada, Pakistan, India, China, Iran, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Turkey, USA.

fake_websites_and_scams: Apply strictly through the official ualberta.ca website.
Beware of immigration agencies claiming to guarantee Canadian university admissions or scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of CAD 135 is paid exclusively via the official online application portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Alberta does not employ educational agents for thesis-based graduate admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian Study Permit & biometrics fee: CAD 235 (~PKR 48,000).
IELTS or TOEFL test fees: ~PKR 55,000 to 65,000.
Initial relocation airfare to Edmonton: ~PKR 250,000 to 350,000.
Winter clothing and initial setup in Edmonton (-30°C winter climate): ~CAD 1,000 (~PKR 205,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can get funded without a supervisor. Reality: In thesis-based programs (especially Computing Science), having a committed faculty supervisor is practically essential for funding.
Myth: Edmonton is too expensive for students. Reality: Edmonton has significantly lower rental and living costs compared to Toronto or Vancouver, making stipends go much further.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim funding is automatic for all admitted students; guaranteed funding packages apply strictly to thesis-based programs, not course-based Master's.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative graduate GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 throughout each academic year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus residency in Edmonton and active engagement in thesis research and coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress report submitted jointly with supervisor to the Department Graduate Coordinator and GPS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistant (TA) or Research Assistant (RA) appointments are limited to a maximum of 12 hours per week during academic terms to ensure focus on thesis research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for a 3-year Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill assigned GRA/GTA duties up to 12 hours/week.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship funding ceases if student switches to part-time study, withdraws, or fails to maintain academic good standing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from current supervisor, new department, and Faculty of GPS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Stipend support beyond the standard guaranteed period (2 years MSc, 4 years PhD) is at the discretion of the supervisor's research grants.
